primitives.name: Zero-Cost Infrastructure Anchor
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Oracle Cloud Always Free VPS** — host BullMQ workers + self-hosted Redis + henrygd on a free ARM box.
primitives.assumptions: Resource usage remains within Always Free tier limits; no idle reclamation risk.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( U_{\text{compute}} > 1500 \text{ OCPU-hrs} \) or \( U_{\text{storage}} > 9000 \text{ GB-hrs} \)

layer2.mapping: Infrastructure cost function \( C_{\text{infra}} \) maps to a constant zero under free-tier constraints, enabling a dual optimization of utility vs. cost.
layer2.telemetry: Monthly OCPU and storage consumption tracked via Oracle Cloud console.

primitives.name: Cookieless Analytics Pipeline
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Cloudflare Web Analytics** — $0 site analytics, cookieless, JS-snippet works on Vercel (no need to proxy DNS).
primitives.assumptions: No user tracking or cookie collection; JS snippet deployed correctly.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( A_{\text{analytics}} > 10^6 \) or privacy compliance fails.

layer2.mapping: Analytics utility \( U_{\text{data}} \) is derived from \( A_{\text{analytics}} \) and \( P_{\text{privacy}} \), with \( C_{\text{analytics}} = 0 \).
layer2.telemetry: Pageview count and privacy compliance metrics from Cloudflare dashboard.

primitives.name: Free Security Scanning
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Snyk free** — dependency + code vuln scanning in CI.
primitives.assumptions: Scans are performed within free-tier limits (200 SCA, 100 SAST, etc.).

layer2.mapping: Security risk \( R_{\text{risk}} \) is inversely proportional to \( T_{\text{coverage}} \), with \( C_{\text{security}} = 0 \).
layer2.telemetry: Scan counts and vulnerability reports from Snyk dashboard.
